```{julia}
one_fig = Makie.Figure(resolution = (800, cfg[!, :n_bees][1]*300))
agentids = unique(states.bee_id)
taskids = unique(states.task_id)
for (i,t) in enumerate(taskids)
    t_df = subset(
        states,
        :task_id => ByRow(==(t))
    )
    ax = Makie.Axis(one_fig[i,1], xlabel="epoch", ylabel="accuracy", title= "$(task_index[t])")
    for a in agentids
        a_df = subset(
            t_df,
            :bee_id => ByRow(==(a))
        )
        Makie.lines!(ax, a_df.epoch, a_df.accuracies)
    end
end
```
